macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the pixel width of the left horn base.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the orbital regions and two distinct white spots on the lower mandible/cheek area.
